about_the_game:
Welcome to the OrePlant Demo Version!

Curious souls Finn and Maru are suddenly swept away into a mysterious new world by an unknown magical force! In this world, a legendary World Tree stands tall—and with your touch, this enchanting land can come back to life. Join your adorable companion Aria and explore, restore, and nurture this magical realm together!

Key Features

🎣 Fishing with the Adorable 'Dambi'

Fishing just got cuter with your little weasel friend Dambi! 🦦💖
Relax by the water and enjoy healing moments as you fish together.

🤖 Grow Minerals with Helpful Robots

Automated robots help you cultivate mineral plants! ⛏️🌿
Increase efficiency and manage your farm like a pro.

🍳 A Variety of Cooking Systems

Use harvested crops and caught fish to cook a wide range of dishes!
Finished meals grant your characters useful buffs. 🍽️✨

🎥 Immersive Storytelling & Direction

A warm, engaging narrative awaits you.
Embark on a heartwarming adventure with charming and unique characters.

🏡 Customize Your Own Farm

Create your cozy space with your own style! 🌳✨
Decorate freely using a variety of items and backgrounds. 🌄

Important Notes

This demo version contains only a portion of the full experience. The complete version will include richer content and greater freedom.

Check out these exciting features in the full version

🪴 More crops and giant minerals await you.
🤖 A wider variety of automation robots and equipment will be available.
🍳 Additional recipes unlock deeper cooking possibilities.
🎣 Many more fish species and a full bait system will be introduced.
🧰 Equipment upgrades and collectible guides will be included.
🌳 The main story of world revival will fully unfold.
🎼 Play music and interact with many unique characters.
🛍️ Shops will be open for buying and selling useful items.
🏺 A full museum experience with artifact collection and displays.
📊 Track your progress with detailed statistics and player data.
🌾 Explore more land and diverse terrains.
🐾 Meet new animal friends beyond the cat!
🏡 Even more items to personalize your beautiful space.

Recommended for Players Who

Enjoy relaxing and healing gameplay
Love cute graphics and fun decorating elements
Want a mix of farming, fishing, cooking, and casual mechanics
Are fans of games like Stardew Valley or Rusty’s Retirement

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 (Integrated) or Vulkan-compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realteak

  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: Realteak

short_description: 🌱 OrePlant is an idle simulation game where you grow minerals on your farm! 🎣 Fish, 🍳 cook, and 🏡 decorate while exploring a fantasy world centered around the legendary World Tree. Join your adorable companions 'Finn' and 'Aria' on a relaxing and magical journey!
